name: task_spawn_batch
description: Spawn multiple independent subagent tasks (1 to 8 per batch) in one deterministic batch. Every item is preflight-validated before any child starts; spawn attempts run in input order and returned task entries preserve that order. Runtime spawn failures are reported per item without hiding already-started tasks.

tasks.description: Independent subagent tasks to preflight and spawn in input order.

description.description: Short description of what this task will do (3-10 words).

prompt.description: The task/prompt to send to the subagent. Be specific about what you want accomplished.

agent.description: Optional subagent name. Leave empty to let the runtime auto-select the best subagent.

model.description: Optional model override. Default: reuse parent model; override only when the subtask is clearly lighter or heavier.

inherit.description: Optional inheritance control: 'all' (history, memory, cwd, skills), 'none' (fresh context), or a comma-separated subset of history, memory, cwd, skills. Default: cwd+skills only (history and memory kept private). Prefer 'none' or 'cwd' for narrow leaf tasks; use 'all' only when the subtask depends on the full conversation.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the final output; the child must return exactly one value matching it.
